faqs.question: What is the difference between CAT6 and CAT6A cabling?
faqs.answer: CAT6 supports speeds up to 1 Gbps at 100 meters and 10 Gbps up to 55 meters. CAT6A supports 10 Gbps at full 100-meter distances and provides superior shielding against industrial electromagnetic interference (EMI).

faqs.question: What is the difference between an Offline UPS and an Online UPS?
faqs.answer: An offline UPS has a transfer delay of 5-10ms which can cause servers and sensitive networking switches to reboot. An Online UPS continuously converts AC to DC to AC with 0ms transfer time and clean sine wave output.
